_about: THE persona image map (Ed 2026-10-21, issue #241). One entry per AI teammate whose approved photo set is managed here. To update: put the approved PNGs in a folder and run `node scripts/build_persona_images.js <persona> <folder>`; it writes every derived file below. The canonical square at public/assets/presentations/team/<persona>.jpg is what every surface reads (email signature headshot, Ask Amanda, board portal, presentations, training, proposals, outbox) and what scripts/set_team_photos.js pushes to Microsoft 365. Teammates not listed here are unchanged. Each entry's identity_reference is the face every photo must match.
